text: 证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，新形势下推进资本市场改革发展稳定，有很多重大理论和实践问题需要抓紧深化研究。A股市场有2亿多股票投资者、8亿多基金持有人，这要求在市场建设中，既要研究借鉴成熟市场发展的一般规律，更要深入研究中国的市场特点和面临的结构性问题，坚持市场化、法治化、国际化改革方向的同时，统筹好稳与进、效率与公平、发展与安全等辩证关系，坚定走好中国特色金融发展之路。
text_en: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that under the new situation, advancing the reform, development and stability of the capital market involves many major theoretical and practical issues that need to be urgently and deeply studied. The A-share market has more than 200 million stock investors and more than 800 million fund holders, which requires that in market development we should not only study and learn from the general laws of mature market development, but also conduct in-depth research on China's market characteristics and structural problems it faces. While adhering to the direction of market-oriented, law-based and internationalized reform, we should coordinate dialectical relationships such as stability and progress, efficiency and fairness, and development and security, and firmly follow the path of financial development with Chinese characteristics.
